title: Sources, tools and test bootstrap
purpose: Pin engine/toolchain/plugin evidence; establish paths, IDs, documentation and dedicated-server build prerequisites.
stop_condition: Installation record, source provenance, plugin gate and a blank C++ project created by the developer.

title: Sprite, camera and layering lab
purpose: Prove a common body on 3D ground with four facings, zoom, depth, feet and a clothing fallback.
stop_condition: Local capsule and layered sprite remain aligned through four facings; art source gap stays explicit.

title: Three-dimensional locomotion
purpose: Use CharacterMovement across X/Y with Z height; add jump, sprint, dodge, swim and fall/shoreline rules.
stop_condition: One movement integrator; no X/Z plane constraint or sprite-collision authority.

title: Dedicated server and two clients
purpose: Connect independent clients, possess once, replicate movement and remote appearance intent.
stop_condition: Two remote clients with server authority; connection loss cleans up input and references.

title: Accounts and character creation
purpose: Use a development authenticator boundary; create/list/select a named class/body/appearance record.
stop_condition: Creation is server/backend validated; previews never become persistent authority.

title: Durable character service
purpose: Create the versioned schema, command receipts, session fencing and minimal reward/item identities.
stop_condition: One character lease; retry after a lost acknowledgement returns the existing receipt.

title: Two-zone handoff
purpose: Author two zone catalogs/gates, allocate two servers and transfer only one player.
stop_condition: ClientTravel changes that client only; stale source writes and duplicate tickets reject.

title: GAS and authoritative combat
purpose: Initialize PlayerState/enemy ASCs; prove costs, cooldowns, target checks, melee and projectiles.
stop_condition: Accepted attacks apply once without animation notifies and correct predicted UI on rejection.

title: AI, defeat credit, XP and recovery
purpose: Build server AI and defeat ledger, minimal party eligibility, XP awards and safe respawn.
stop_condition: Slice A: two players fight and receive recorded XP; death and reconnect do not repeat rewards.

title: Items, bags and equipment
purpose: Create real inventory UI/stack rules, item requirements and replicated logical/visual equipment.
stop_condition: Capacity/conflict errors do not partially move gear; missing clothing keeps item stats.

title: Weighted loot and ownership
purpose: Materialize loot once for a defeated spawn generation; expose corpse/container interaction.
stop_condition: Guaranteed and random allocations remain unchanged after reload and replay.

title: Merchants, currency and bank
purpose: Commit buy/sell/buyback/repair and deposits/withdrawals through authenticated service commands.
stop_condition: Concurrent last-stock/slot/currency operations have one coherent result.

title: Randomized mining and woodcutting
purpose: Select eligible sites per zone seed; validate tools, action leases, yield, XP and respawn.
stop_condition: Two players contest the same node and exactly one depleted-generation grant succeeds.

title: Crafting professions
purpose: Learn recipes, use stations and consume materials/currency atomically for deterministic items.
stop_condition: Disconnect after confirm and reconnect in another zone preserves exactly one crafted result.

title: Fishing
purpose: Validate shoreline casts, world bobber, bite window, reel and terminal fish reward.
stop_condition: One fishing attempt has one terminal outcome; replay/notify/restart cannot add catches.

title: Village dialogue and quest loop
purpose: Author conditional NPC dialogue and a quest DAG using server gameplay events and receipt-backed rewards.
stop_condition: Slice B includes quest/fight/loot/gather/fish/craft/shop/equip/death/reconnect.

title: Four-class talents and progression
purpose: Build all four ability catalogs, validated skill graph, derived stats and paid respec.
stop_condition: Exclusive branches and prerequisites hold; respec cannot strand required progression.

title: Exploration and world production
purpose: Add discovery/minimap, time/weather, six region plans and a data-driven content factory.
stop_condition: New zones register without native rule changes; weather/discovery survive transfer policies.

title: Elites, bosses and dungeons
purpose: Add phases/telegraphs, four-player instanced ruin allocation and recovery/loot rules.
stop_condition: Party reservation is atomic; boss defeat/reset/instance retry grants only intended rewards.

title: Social and secure trade
purpose: Extend minimal parties into invites/chat/friends/block/private messages and escrow trades.
stop_condition: Blocking and moderation affect delivery; both trade acceptances bind one offer revision.

title: Reputation, trainers and hubs
purpose: Add faction thresholds, profession/class training, safe-hub unlocks and world event participation.
stop_condition: Server-recorded reputation and paid travel/training are validated and durable.

title: Guilds and committed growth
purpose: Add guild roles/invites, social dashboards, content expansion; mounts stay behind an art/movement gate.
stop_condition: Guild mutations are authorized and versioned; no unverified mounted art is enabled.

title: Operations, security and measured scale
purpose: Exercise restarts, restores, fencing, dupe attacks, deployment and replication comparisons.
stop_condition: Publish measured budgets and incident runbooks; do not substitute actor counts for real load tests.

title: Packaged release-candidate proof
purpose: Run complete packaged client/server slices, localization/accessibility and documentation consistency.
stop_condition: Slice C requires retained test evidence, recovery proof and no unresolved critical economy failures.
